critique: Every graded review carries the trailer by contract, so details.citations is wrong on every input and recall is inflated for any defect anchored in a file's first four lines. A signal or set -e exit between :656 and :659 leaves the temp file, which holds cheval's complete stderr (provider error bodies, request ids), in a world-readable TMPDIR. New in this PR (base used 2>/dev/null).
finding: Untrapped temp file holding cheval's full stderr; silent abort when mktemp fails
remediation: trap 'rm -f -- "$err_file"' EXIT after mktemp, or use a process substitution grep instead of a file; wrap mktemp with || { error ...; exit 1; }.
